form.description: JSON Render root/elements/state document, encoded as a JSON string. No Markdown fence.

tools.name: bash
tools.description: Execute a workspace command using the Bash execution target in <env>. Its OS/shell can differ from the host. Use for commands, package installation, and tests.

command.description: Exact command for the execution target OS/shell in <env>. require_escalated selects the workspace command runner only after exact-invocation authorization.

sandbox_permissions.description: use_default (or omit): configured sandbox; fail closed if absent. require_escalated: necessary host execution after sandbox denial and interactive host approval. request_network_grant: after network denial, ask permission for exactly network_grant.host/port, then run sandboxed.

justification.description: With require_escalated, explain why the workspace sandbox cannot run the command.

host.description: Exact host, no wildcards. localhost and 127.0.0.1 never alias.

port.description: Omit for any port on the host; otherwise pin this port.

network_grant.description: Required with request_network_grant; the user must authorize this exact origin.

tools.name: batch
tools.description: Run independent same-step calls concurrently; put dependencies in later steps. Bind an earlier result with the single-key argument object {"$ref":"files.output_lines.0"} (invocation id plus result path), not a JSON Schema fragment URI. Each call supplies a tool and args.

invocations.description: Calls grouped by step; later steps may bind earlier results as described above.

args.description: Argument object; values may be JSON or a single-key $ref binding to an earlier step.

step.description: Dependency group; same-step calls see no peer results. Later steps may bind earlier results.

max_concurrency.description: Concurrency; default 8, max 16. Mutating/non-idempotent calls serialize.

tools.name: code_diagnostics
tools.description: Return language diagnostics for saved workspace code. Provide path for one document or omit it for a bounded manifest-backed workspace query. For document queries only, an empty items array means diagnostics were received and cleared. Workspace queries start relevant language runtimes; truncated can also mean partial language coverage.

path.description: Optional saved workspace document path. Omit for workspace diagnostics.

tools.name: code_navigation
tools.description: Navigate saved workspace code by language semantics. Resolves definitions, declarations, references, or implementations from a zero-based UTF-16 position. Each result includes one declaration line and not the function body; use read when the full body is needed.

path.description: Saved workspace document path.

tools.name: code_symbols
tools.description: Query semantic symbols from saved workspace files. The outline operation returns the hierarchy of one document. The search operation returns one declaration line and not the function body. Use read when the full body is needed.

path.description: Saved workspace document path. Required for outline.

query.description: Semantic symbol query. Required for search.

limit.description: Maximum workspace symbols for search. Default: 100; maximum: 500.

tools.name: download
tools.description: Download an HTTP(S) resource into the local workspace. Streams binary data to an adjacent temporary file, verifies Range responses and optional SHA-256, then atomically promotes the completed file. Supports adaptive 1-4 connection downloads, bounded retries, cancellation, and sequential fallback.

url.description: Required. Public http:// or https:// URL. Signed query parameters are preserved for the request but never returned in metadata.

file_path.description: Optional workspace-relative destination. When omitted, a safe filename is inferred from Content-Disposition, URL query/path, or download.bin.

overwrite.description: Optional. Replace an existing regular file only after the new download is complete and verified. Default: false.

connections.description: Optional. Requested parallel Range connections (1-4). Omit for adaptive selection based on file size.

max_bytes.description: Optional hard limit for declared and streamed bytes. Default: 536870912 (512 MiB); maximum: 8589934592 (8 GiB).

timeout.description: Optional total timeout in seconds, including retries, verification, and atomic promotion. Default: 300; maximum: 3600.

expected_sha256.description: Optional expected lowercase or uppercase SHA-256 hex digest. The final file is not promoted when verification fails.

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Replace exact strings using old_string/new_string or one atomic ordered edits array per file. Every entry is validated before writing; old_string must be unique unless replace_all. LF/CRLF match and retain the file's endings; mixed/CR-only endings are refused.

edits.description: Ordered atomic same-file replacements; mutually exclusive with old_string/new_string.

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence for this entry; default false.

old_string.description: Single-edit match; required unless edits is used. Unique unless replace_all=true.

new_string.description: Single-edit replacement; required unless edits is used.

dry_run.description: Preview exact diff/count without writing; default false.

max_replacements.description: Reject before writing if the whole-call replacement count exceeds this ceiling.

expected_replacements.description: Reject before writing unless the whole-call replacement count equals this value.

tools.name: generate_object
tools.description: Generate a JSON value that strictly conforms to a provided JSON Schema. Use when you need structured output: extracting fields from text, classifying data, converting natural language to typed records, or producing machine-readable results. The root value may be an object, array, or scalar. Returns the validated value on success.

schema.description: JSON Schema that the output value must conform to

schema_name.description: Short name for the schema (used internally for tool naming)

schema_description.description: Optional description of what the schema represents

prompt.description: The prompt describing what value to generate or extract

system.description: Optional system prompt to guide generation

mode.description: Output mode. 'auto' selects the best mode for the provider. 'tool' uses tool-calling (most reliable cross-provider). 'strict' uses OpenAI native JSON schema. 'json' uses json_object mode. 'prompt' appends schema to prompt.

max_repair_attempts.description: Maximum repair attempts if output fails validation (0-5)

include_raw_text.description: Include the raw model text/tool arguments used to extract the final value. Defaults to false to avoid exposing reasoning-channel text.

timeout_ms.description: Active generation deadline in milliseconds. Admission queue wait is excluded. Default 120000; maximum 600000.

tools.name: get_task_output
tools.description: Query an existing child task by task_id. Set timeout_ms to wait up to 300000 ms; 0 polls. A timeout leaves the task running. Never relaunch a task to wait for it.

tools.name: git
tools.description: Git operations in the current workspace.

path.description: Path for worktree operations.

target.description: Diff target ref; omit for working-tree diff.

limit.description: Entries per page; default 10 (log), 50 (other lists), max 200.

cursor.description: Exact prior cursor for log/branch/stash/remote/worktree lists.

byte_offset.description: Byte offset for the next diff page.

max_bytes.description: Diff UTF-8 byte limit; default 65536, max 102400.

remote_name.description: Remote name; reserved for provider-specific filtering.

tools.name: kill_task
tools.description: Request cancellation of an existing child task by task_id. Returns the observed status; cancellation does not mean cleanup has finished.

tools.name: ls
tools.description: List contents of a directory with file types and sizes.

path.description: Optional. Directory path to list. Default: workspace root.

limit.description: Optional. Maximum entries to return. Default: 200; maximum: 1000.

cursor.description: Optional. Omit on the first call. On a continuation, copy the exact opaque cursor returned by the previous ls call; never invent a placeholder.

tools.name: output_check
tools.description: Check text length, percentage changes, date spans or every adjacent sequence change in process, without Bash. text_length counts Unicode extended grapheme clusters (user-perceived characters, so ZWJ emoji sequences count as 1) including punctuation/whitespace, non-whitespace clusters, and whitespace-delimited words. percentage_change uses (current-previous)/abs(previous)*100, returns full numeric values and signed prose rounded to at most 2 decimals with ASCII signs (+10%, -50%); explicit user precision still takes precedence. date_span requires exact YYYY-MM-DD dates and explicit elapsed or inclusive endpoint counting; reversed dates are refused. sequence_changes returns every adjacent difference and every decrease with zero-based indices; missing values leave the complete-sequence conclusion unknown. record_provenance compares source and output records by key and reports missing, unexpected, duplicate and changed records; allow_derived_keys is only for task-authorized derived records. Missing values and zero baselines are never converted to zero changes. These measurements do not establish business meaning or resolve conflicting user requirements; compare every final claim with its source and counting rule.

end.description: Required for date_span: YYYY-MM-DD, on or after start.

endpoint_counting.description: Required for date_span. elapsed counts end minus start; inclusive counts both endpoints.

values.description: Required for sequence_changes, in source order; null is missing.

compare_fields.description: Fields to compare; omitted compares all source fields except the key.

tools.name: patch
tools.description: Apply a unified diff patch to one file (file_path + diff), or several files in ONE all-or-nothing call (patches: [{file_path, diff}, ...] — every diff is validated in memory before any write, so a bad hunk anywhere changes nothing). Prefer the patches form when editing two or more files in the same step, and one diff with several hunks when several regions of one file change together. String-based `edit` with an `edits` array is easier when exact line numbers are unknown.

file_path.description: Single-file mode: path to the file to patch. Use exactly this field name.

diff.description: Unified diff content with @@ hunk headers for file_path.

patches.description: Multi-file mode: one entry per file, applied all-or-nothing. Takes precedence over file_path/diff.

file_path.description: Path to the file this entry patches.

diff.description: Unified diff with @@ hunk headers for this file only.

tools.name: program

inputs.description: Script second argument, or declared template parameters.

source.description: Inline JavaScript defining async function run(ctx, inputs).

path.description: Workspace-relative .js/.mjs defining async function run(ctx, inputs); used when source is omitted.

allowed_tools.description: Callable ctx tools; default all registered except program, dynamic_workflow and legacy parallel_task.

name.description: Exact registered name; required for template.

query.description: Regex or literal pattern to search for.

path.description: Workspace-relative path to search.
Workspace-relative path to map.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read text/images or batch 1-32 text files under one output budget. Returns line numbers and exact continuations. Lines over 2000 bytes are cut; use the returned byte_offset to resume.

file_path.description: Absolute/workspace-relative file or aster://tool-output/... URI from a tool result. Choose file_path or files.

byte_offset.description: Byte index in the first returned line only (default 0, at most its length); later lines are whole. Resume with the returned line offset and byte_offset.

files.description: Text ranges in request order, sharing one output budget. Per-member errors preserve successful members.

path.description: Absolute/workspace-relative text file.

byte_offset.description: Byte index in this entry's first returned line; default 0, at most its length.

limit.description: Line limit for this file; default/max 2000.

max_output_bytes.description: Shared batch byte budget, including continuation; default 65536, max 98304.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the workspace with one model-selected mode. Use grep for an exact string or regex, glob for file names, bm25 for ranked lexical matches, hybrid to fuse available evidence channels.

mode.description: Select a listed mode; bm25 may automatically use the durable local index.

path.description: Workspace-relative directory/file, or aster://tool-output/... URI (grep only); default workspace root.

output_mode.description: grep: content (default) pages matches with context; files_with_matches/count page files; summary returns totals.

tools.name: task
tools.description: Delegate one bounded child or independent tasks concurrently. Background supports one item; multiple items are collected by the parent. Any child failure fails the group by default; allow_partial_failure permits partial success. Use canonical live-catalog names. Custom agents: agent_dirs or .aster/agents; .claude/agents remains compatible.

tasks.description: One focused child, or independent children concurrently.

agent.description:
Canonical name from the live agent catalog:
explore: Fast read-only exploration agent. Use for searching files, reading code, understanding codebase structure, and gathering external web evidence.
general: General-purpose agent for multi-step task execution. Can read, write, and execute commands.
plan: Planning agent for designing implementation approaches. Read-only access to explore codebase and create plans.
review: Code review agent focused on correctness, regressions, security, maintainability, and clear findings.
verification: Verification agent for adversarial validation. Prefer real checks, reproductions, and regression testing over code reading alone.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema for the child result; a coerced, validated object returns in metadata.

background.description: Run in background; only a single-item outer tasks array supports this. Default false.

allow_partial_failure.description: task succeeds when any child succeeds; failed children stay in content/metadata. Default false.

timeout_ms.description: Collection deadline in ms; completed results return and unfinished children fail.

min_success_count.description: Return early after this many successes; requires allow_partial_failure.

tools.name: update_plan
tools.description: Replace the live task checklist shown to the user. Pass the full plan array on every call. Use for multi-step work: create 2–8 concrete steps early, keep exactly one in_progress, and mark steps completed as you finish. Skip for trivial single-step requests.

plan.description: Required. Complete ordered checklist. Each call replaces the previous list.

status.description: Required. Step status. Prefer exactly one in_progress while working.

id.description: Optional stable id. Defaults to plan-{index}.

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.description: Fetch content from a URL and convert to text or markdown. Supports HTML to Markdown conversion and text extraction from PDF documents. 5MB download size limit and capped tool output. Configurable timeout (max 120 seconds).

url.description: Required. The URL to fetch content from. Must start with http:// or https://. Always provide this exact field name: 'url'.

timeout.description: Optional. Timeout in seconds. Default: 30. Maximum: 120.

body_only.description: Optional. For HTML responses, extract the semantic main element when present, otherwise the body element, before conversion. Default: true.

offset.description: Optional. Character offset into the converted content. Default: 0.

max_chars.description: Optional. Maximum converted characters to return. Default: 50000; maximum: 100000.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: When saved notes are available, this tool searches them before the network. A matching note is returned and the web is not queried. Call web_search again with the same query if those passages do not answer. Search the web through a structurally gated cascade of native APIs and HTTP/RSS engines. Unavailable engines are skipped through session-scoped circuit state, and all executed tiers are deduplicated and ranked together. An explicit engines list runs only those requested tiers. Supports proxy configuration for conventional search transports.

query.description: Required. The search query. Always provide this exact field name: 'query'.

engines.description: Optional. List of search engines or native providers to use. Without explicit configuration, all built-in providers that advertise anonymous access are combined with the public HTTP defaults. Available: anysearch (anonymous or authenticated native provider), tavily (keyless or authenticated native provider), ddg (DuckDuckGo), brave (Brave Search), bing (Bing RSS), wiki (Wikipedia), sogou (Sogou), 360 / so360 (360 Search), bing_cn (Bing China RSS), and opt-in billed providers tinyfish, bocha, aliyun, tencent, firecrawl, and aster (named only; they are not in the default cascade).

limit.description: Optional. Maximum number of results to return. Default: 10. Maximum: 50.

timeout.description: Optional. Search timeout in seconds. Default: 20. Maximum: 60.

proxy.description: Optional. Proxy URL, for example http://127.0.0.1:8080 or socks5://127.0.0.1:1080.

format.description: Optional. Output format. Default: json for complete results; degraded-source context stays text. Explicit text is always honored.

full_text_bytes.description: Optional. For JSON output, include at most this many UTF-8 bytes of provider-returned full source text per result. Omitted by default.

tools.name: write
tools.description: Write a file (default overwrite), or append bounded chunks after the first write with expected_offset for safe retries.

content.description: Full replacement/first chunk for overwrite; next chunk for append.

mode.description: overwrite replaces the file (default); append adds a chunk and requires expected_offset.

expected_offset.description: Append requires the stored UTF-8 byte size. Chunks adopt existing line endings; continue from the reported size. Matching already-applied chunks retry successfully; other mismatches fail. Overwrite may omit this or send neutral 0 (ignored).

path.description: Optional saved workspace document path. Omit for workspace diagnostics.

tools.name: code_navigation
tools.description: Navigate saved workspace code by language semantics. Resolves definitions, declarations, references, or implementations from a zero-based UTF-16 position. Each result includes one declaration line and not the function body; use read when the full body is needed.

path.description: Saved workspace document path.

tools.name: code_symbols
tools.description: Query semantic symbols from saved workspace files. The outline operation returns the hierarchy of one document. The search operation returns one declaration line and not the function body. Use read when the full body is needed.

path.description: Saved workspace document path. Required for outline.

query.description: Semantic symbol query. Required for search.

limit.description: Maximum workspace symbols for search. Default: 100; maximum: 500.

tools.name: download
tools.description: Download an HTTP(S) resource into the local workspace. Streams binary data to an adjacent temporary file, verifies Range responses and optional SHA-256, then atomically promotes the completed file. Supports adaptive 1-4 connection downloads, bounded retries, cancellation, and sequential fallback.

url.description: Required. Public http:// or https:// URL. Signed query parameters are preserved for the request but never returned in metadata.

file_path.description: Optional workspace-relative destination. When omitted, a safe filename is inferred from Content-Disposition, URL query/path, or download.bin.

overwrite.description: Optional. Replace an existing regular file only after the new download is complete and verified. Default: false.

connections.description: Optional. Requested parallel Range connections (1-4). Omit for adaptive selection based on file size.

max_bytes.description: Optional hard limit for declared and streamed bytes. Default: 536870912 (512 MiB); maximum: 8589934592 (8 GiB).

timeout.description: Optional total timeout in seconds, including retries, verification, and atomic promotion. Default: 300; maximum: 3600.

expected_sha256.description: Optional expected lowercase or uppercase SHA-256 hex digest. The final file is not promoted when verification fails.

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Replace exact strings using old_string/new_string or one atomic ordered edits array per file. Every entry is validated before writing; old_string must be unique unless replace_all. LF/CRLF match and retain the file's endings; mixed/CR-only endings are refused.

edits.description: Ordered atomic same-file replacements; mutually exclusive with old_string/new_string.

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence for this entry; default false.

old_string.description: Single-edit match; required unless edits is used. Unique unless replace_all=true.

new_string.description: Single-edit replacement; required unless edits is used.

dry_run.description: Preview exact diff/count without writing; default false.

max_replacements.description: Reject before writing if the whole-call replacement count exceeds this ceiling.

expected_replacements.description: Reject before writing unless the whole-call replacement count equals this value.

tools.name: generate_object
tools.description: Generate a JSON value that strictly conforms to a provided JSON Schema. Use when you need structured output: extracting fields from text, classifying data, converting natural language to typed records, or producing machine-readable results. The root value may be an object, array, or scalar. Returns the validated value on success.

schema.description: JSON Schema that the output value must conform to

schema_name.description: Short name for the schema (used internally for tool naming)

schema_description.description: Optional description of what the schema represents

prompt.description: The prompt describing what value to generate or extract

system.description: Optional system prompt to guide generation

mode.description: Output mode. 'auto' selects the best mode for the provider. 'tool' uses tool-calling (most reliable cross-provider). 'strict' uses OpenAI native JSON schema. 'json' uses json_object mode. 'prompt' appends schema to prompt.

max_repair_attempts.description: Maximum repair attempts if output fails validation (0-5)

include_raw_text.description: Include the raw model text/tool arguments used to extract the final value. Defaults to false to avoid exposing reasoning-channel text.

timeout_ms.description: Active generation deadline in milliseconds. Admission queue wait is excluded. Default 120000; maximum 600000.

tools.name: get_task_output
tools.description: Query an existing child task by task_id. Set timeout_ms to wait up to 300000 ms; 0 polls. A timeout leaves the task running. Never relaunch a task to wait for it.

tools.name: git
tools.description: Git operations in the current workspace.

path.description: Path for worktree operations.

target.description: Diff target ref; omit for working-tree diff.

limit.description: Entries per page; default 10 (log), 50 (other lists), max 200.

cursor.description: Exact prior cursor for log/branch/stash/remote/worktree lists.

byte_offset.description: Byte offset for the next diff page.

max_bytes.description: Diff UTF-8 byte limit; default 65536, max 102400.

remote_name.description: Remote name; reserved for provider-specific filtering.

tools.name: kill_task
tools.description: Request cancellation of an existing child task by task_id. Returns the observed status; cancellation does not mean cleanup has finished.

tools.name: ls
tools.description: List contents of a directory with file types and sizes.

path.description: Optional. Directory path to list. Default: workspace root.

limit.description: Optional. Maximum entries to return. Default: 200; maximum: 1000.

cursor.description: Optional. Omit on the first call. On a continuation, copy the exact opaque cursor returned by the previous ls call; never invent a placeholder.

tools.name: output_check
tools.description: Check text length, percentage changes, date spans or every adjacent sequence change in process, without Bash. text_length counts Unicode extended grapheme clusters (user-perceived characters, so ZWJ emoji sequences count as 1) including punctuation/whitespace, non-whitespace clusters, and whitespace-delimited words. percentage_change uses (current-previous)/abs(previous)*100, returns full numeric values and signed prose rounded to at most 2 decimals with ASCII signs (+10%, -50%); explicit user precision still takes precedence. date_span requires exact YYYY-MM-DD dates and explicit elapsed or inclusive endpoint counting; reversed dates are refused. sequence_changes returns every adjacent difference and every decrease with zero-based indices; missing values leave the complete-sequence conclusion unknown. record_provenance compares source and output records by key and reports missing, unexpected, duplicate and changed records; allow_derived_keys is only for task-authorized derived records. Missing values and zero baselines are never converted to zero changes. These measurements do not establish business meaning or resolve conflicting user requirements; compare every final claim with its source and counting rule.

end.description: Required for date_span: YYYY-MM-DD, on or after start.

endpoint_counting.description: Required for date_span. elapsed counts end minus start; inclusive counts both endpoints.

values.description: Required for sequence_changes, in source order; null is missing.

compare_fields.description: Fields to compare; omitted compares all source fields except the key.

tools.name: patch
tools.description: Apply a unified diff patch to one file (file_path + diff), or several files in ONE all-or-nothing call (patches: [{file_path, diff}, ...] — every diff is validated in memory before any write, so a bad hunk anywhere changes nothing). Prefer the patches form when editing two or more files in the same step, and one diff with several hunks when several regions of one file change together. String-based `edit` with an `edits` array is easier when exact line numbers are unknown.

file_path.description: Single-file mode: path to the file to patch. Use exactly this field name.

diff.description: Unified diff content with @@ hunk headers for file_path.

patches.description: Multi-file mode: one entry per file, applied all-or-nothing. Takes precedence over file_path/diff.

file_path.description: Path to the file this entry patches.

diff.description: Unified diff with @@ hunk headers for this file only.

tools.name: program
tools.description:
Run a sandboxed JavaScript PTC script. The script defines async function run(ctx, inputs) and may call only allowed ctx tools. Or run a registered template with type="template", its exact name, and inputs. Available templates:
- program_code_search: Search code with a bounded grep pass and return file/line matches. Parameters: [{"name":"query","description":"Regex or literal pattern to search for.","required":true},{"name":"path","description":"Workspace-relative path to search.","required":false,"default":"."},{"name":"glob","description":"Optional file glob filter.","required":false,"default":"*"}]
- program_repo_map: Map the repository shape with root listing and key project files. Parameters: [{"name":"path","description":"Workspace-relative path to map.","required":false,"default":"."}]

type.description: script: JavaScript source/path; template: registered name.

inputs.description: Script second argument, or declared template parameters.

source.description: Inline JavaScript defining async function run(ctx, inputs).

path.description: Workspace-relative .js/.mjs defining async function run(ctx, inputs); used when source is omitted.

allowed_tools.description: Callable ctx tools; default all registered except program, dynamic_workflow and legacy parallel_task.

name.description: Exact registered name; required for template.

query.description: Regex or literal pattern to search for.

path.description: Workspace-relative path to search.
Workspace-relative path to map.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read text/images or batch 1-32 text files under one output budget. Returns line numbers and exact continuations. Lines over 2000 bytes are cut; use the returned byte_offset to resume.

file_path.description: Absolute/workspace-relative file or aster://tool-output/... URI from a tool result. Choose file_path or files.

byte_offset.description: Byte index in the first returned line only (default 0, at most its length); later lines are whole. Resume with the returned line offset and byte_offset.

files.description: Text ranges in request order, sharing one output budget. Per-member errors preserve successful members.

path.description: Absolute/workspace-relative text file.

byte_offset.description: Byte index in this entry's first returned line; default 0, at most its length.

limit.description: Line limit for this file; default/max 2000.

max_output_bytes.description: Shared batch byte budget, including continuation; default 65536, max 98304.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the workspace with one model-selected mode. Use grep for an exact string or regex, glob for file names, bm25 for ranked lexical matches, hybrid to fuse available evidence channels.

mode.description: Select a listed mode; bm25 may automatically use the durable local index.

path.description: Workspace-relative directory/file, or aster://tool-output/... URI (grep only); default workspace root.

context.description: grep/bm25 context lines; BM25 default 2, max 8.

output_mode.description: grep: content (default) pages matches with context; files_with_matches/count page files; summary returns totals.

limit.description: grep content matches with context, or glob/grep files/count files: default 200, max 1000; bm25/hybrid results: default 10, max 25. Unused by grep summary.

cursor.description: Exact prior opaque cursor for glob/paginated grep.

sort.description: glob: backend preserves backend order (default); path sorts lexically before paging.

examples.query: where session shutdown releases temporary indexes

tools.name: task
tools.description: Delegate one bounded child or independent tasks concurrently. Background supports one item; multiple items are collected by the parent. Any child failure fails the group by default; allow_partial_failure permits partial success. Use canonical live-catalog names. Custom agents: agent_dirs or .aster/agents; .claude/agents remains compatible.

tasks.description: One focused child, or independent children concurrently.

agent.description:
Canonical name from the live agent catalog:
explore: Fast read-only exploration agent. Use for searching files, reading code, understanding codebase structure, and gathering external web evidence.
general: General-purpose agent for multi-step task execution. Can read, write, and execute commands.
plan: Planning agent for designing implementation approaches. Read-only access to explore codebase and create plans.
review: Code review agent focused on correctness, regressions, security, maintainability, and clear findings.
verification: Verification agent for adversarial validation. Prefer real checks, reproductions, and regression testing over code reading alone.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema for the child result; a coerced, validated object returns in metadata.

background.description: Run in background; only a single-item outer tasks array supports this. Default false.

allow_partial_failure.description: task succeeds when any child succeeds; failed children stay in content/metadata. Default false.

timeout_ms.description: Collection deadline in ms; completed results return and unfinished children fail.

min_success_count.description: Return early after this many successes; requires allow_partial_failure.

tasks.prompt: Search the workspace for Rust files and summarize the layout.
Review the relevant code for regression risks.

tools.name: update_plan
tools.description: Replace the live task checklist shown to the user. Pass the full plan array on every call. Use for multi-step work: create 2–8 concrete steps early, keep exactly one in_progress, and mark steps completed as you finish. Skip for trivial single-step requests.

plan.description: Required. Complete ordered checklist. Each call replaces the previous list.

status.description: Required. Step status. Prefer exactly one in_progress while working.

id.description: Optional stable id. Defaults to plan-{index}.

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.description: Fetch content from a URL and convert to text or markdown. Supports HTML to Markdown conversion and text extraction from PDF documents. 5MB download size limit and capped tool output. Configurable timeout (max 120 seconds).

url.description: Required. The URL to fetch content from. Must start with http:// or https://. Always provide this exact field name: 'url'.

timeout.description: Optional. Timeout in seconds. Default: 30. Maximum: 120.

body_only.description: Optional. For HTML responses, extract the semantic main element when present, otherwise the body element, before conversion. Default: true.

offset.description: Optional. Character offset into the converted content. Default: 0.

max_chars.description: Optional. Maximum converted characters to return. Default: 50000; maximum: 100000.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: When saved notes are available, this tool searches them before the network. A matching note is returned and the web is not queried. Call web_search again with the same query if those passages do not answer. Search the web through a structurally gated cascade of native APIs and HTTP/RSS engines. Unavailable engines are skipped through session-scoped circuit state, and all executed tiers are deduplicated and ranked together. An explicit engines list runs only those requested tiers. Supports proxy configuration for conventional search transports.

query.description: Required. The search query. Always provide this exact field name: 'query'.

engines.description: Optional. List of search engines or native providers to use. Without explicit configuration, all built-in providers that advertise anonymous access are combined with the public HTTP defaults. Available: anysearch (anonymous or authenticated native provider), tavily (keyless or authenticated native provider), ddg (DuckDuckGo), brave (Brave Search), bing (Bing RSS), wiki (Wikipedia), sogou (Sogou), 360 / so360 (360 Search), bing_cn (Bing China RSS), and opt-in billed providers tinyfish, bocha, aliyun, tencent, firecrawl, and aster (named only; they are not in the default cascade).

limit.description: Optional. Maximum number of results to return. Default: 10. Maximum: 50.

timeout.description: Optional. Search timeout in seconds. Default: 20. Maximum: 60.

proxy.description: Optional. Proxy URL, for example http://127.0.0.1:8080 or socks5://127.0.0.1:1080.

format.description: Optional. Output format. Default: json for complete results; degraded-source context stays text. Explicit text is always honored.

full_text_bytes.description: Optional. For JSON output, include at most this many UTF-8 bytes of provider-returned full source text per result. Omitted by default.

tools.name: write
tools.description: Write a file (default overwrite), or append bounded chunks after the first write with expected_offset for safe retries.

content.description: Full replacement/first chunk for overwrite; next chunk for append.

mode.description: overwrite replaces the file (default); append adds a chunk and requires expected_offset.

expected_offset.description: Append requires the stored UTF-8 byte size. Chunks adopt existing line endings; continue from the reported size. Matching already-applied chunks retry successfully; other mismatches fail. Overwrite may omit this or send neutral 0 (ignored).
